meaning: Transcription of the State 1 candidate fields and the State 6 contract-only types into typed fields, made on 20 September 2026 as the input of the model closure. It is NOT the closure: nothing was invented, so every structure the documents describe in prose without naming its fields is still a plain str here and is listed under questions. Rules of the transcription: references and digests are str, instants are KernelInstant, a closed list of words is str plus closed_value_sets, a stated condition gives '| None' plus conditional_fields.

conditional_fields.SemanticTermRevision.subject_kind: when the meaning is about a referenced entity
conditional_fields.SemanticTermRevision.temporal_role: when the term describes an event or period
conditional_fields.SemanticRelationRevision.required_slot_r: when execution is required: the slot whose function performs the conversion or resolution, which then appears as a node on the path and never as a bare edge
conditional_fields.TemporalValue.instant_utc: exactly one closed representation: `instant_utc` plus original offset when known
conditional_fields.TemporalValue.local_date: exactly one closed representation: `local_date` plus timezone or a timezone-unknown marker
conditional_fields.TemporalValue.start: exactly one closed representation: `start` and `end` with boundary inclusion
conditional_fields.TemporalValue.end: exactly one closed representation: `start` and `end` with boundary inclusion
conditional_fields.MonetaryValue.accepted_assumption_ref: optional when a declared comparison depends on an independently accepted assumption
conditional_fields.PartyReference.revision_ref: optional when exact party facts must be pinned
conditional_fields.WorkScopeReference.revision_ref: optional when exact scope facts must be pinned
conditional_fields.SourceReference.source_revision_ref: when the source description is revisioned
conditional_fields.SourceReference.content_read_binding_ref: optional: the accepted `read` operation binding through which an operation node may obtain the bytes from the owning service
conditional_fields.ActorRef.delegation_id: when the actor is an agent
conditional_fields.ActorRef.channel: when the action arrived over the surface
conditional_fields.AuthenticationThrottleState.last_failure: KernelInstant M47 when at least one failure exists
conditional_fields.AuthenticationThrottleState.blocked_unti: optional KernelInstant M47 while the credential/channel pair is temporarily blocked
conditional_fields.TrialCase.expected_outputs: optional; when present, one bounded value per output port, a file output being compared by digest
conditional_fields.SlotActivation.previous_activation_ref: absent for the first activation of the contract version
conditional_fields.SlotActivation.reason: bounded text, required when the activation returns to an earlier implementation
conditional_fields.FlowNode.contract_version_ref: when the kind is `function` ("Exactly one of the two references is present.")
conditional_fields.FlowNode.binding_version_ref: when the kind is `operation` ("Exactly one of the two references is present.")
conditional_fields.FlowNode.map_over_port: optional; the one `many` input port over whose elements the node is executed once each
conditional_fields.FlowEdge.guard: optional; one output port of the source node whose value schema is a closed set, and the one value that enables this edge
conditional_fields.SpooledBytes.released_at: when the spool entry was emptied
conditional_fields.NodeExecution.approval_ref: `approval_ref` or `grant_ref` when the node required the owner's authority
conditional_fields.NodeExecution.grant_ref: `approval_ref` or `grant_ref` when the node required the owner's authority
conditional_fields.NodeExecution.failure_reason: closed refinement where the status needs one
conditional_fields.EffectApproval.decided_by: present only after the `pending -> approved | denied` transition
conditional_fields.EffectApproval.decided_at: present only after the `pending -> approved | denied` transition
conditional_fields.TrialCaseDefiningContent.expected_output: absent evidence stays distinct from empty evidence
conditional_fields.BindingDriftItem.replacement_binding_ver: A replacement reference is present only for the accepted automatic reissue case.
conditional_fields.VocabularyDecisionResult.governed_entry_: Both references are present only for acceptance. Rejection returns the same proposal in final rejected state and no governed revision.
conditional_fields.VocabularyDecisionResult.issued_revision: Both references are present only for acceptance. Rejection returns the same proposal in final rejected state and no governed revision.
conditional_fields.RunFileAccess.read_lease: The lease is present only when the caller/purpose is authorized to read those exact bytes.
conditional_fields.StoredValueRead.content: Exactly one of content or an unavailable reason is present. A `byte_stream` trial fixture is returned only as a bounded read lease.
conditional_fields.StoredValueRead.content_unavailable_reas: Exactly one of content or an unavailable reason is present.
conditional_fields.SandboxCollectedFile.spooled_ref: Real-run file output uses a run-spool reference; trial collection may expose only the bounded read lease needed by the caller to validate evidence.
conditional_fields.SandboxCollectedFile.read_lease: Real-run file output uses a run-spool reference; trial collection may expose only the bounded read lease needed by the caller to validate evidence.
conditional_fields.TransportResult.response_bytes: At most one response body representation is present.
conditional_fields.TransportResult.response_file: At most one response body representation is present.
conditional_fields.TypedValueDraft.canonical_bytes: Exactly one content representation is present.
conditional_fields.TypedValueDraft.byte_stream: Exactly one content representation is present. `byte_stream` is permitted only for the trial-fixture carriage accepted by the target contract; ordinary flow inputs are value carriage only.
conditional_fields.ImplementationRecordView.code_bytes: Code bytes are present only for the closed `sandbox_execution` purpose.
conditional_fields.HttpResponseEnvelope.error_reason: Both reason fields are absent for a successful result, for a transport or framework refusal and for every authentication refusal.
conditional_fields.HttpResponseEnvelope.error_explanation: Both reason fields are absent for a successful result, for a transport or framework refusal and for every authentication refusal.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.contract_version_ref: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.implementation_ref: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.flow_id: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.flow_version_ref: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.proof_ref: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.expected_current_activ: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.ActivationRequest.reason: The activation kind fixes which reference set is valid; mixed slot/flow targets are refused.
conditional_fields.OwnerDecisionRequest.secondary_ref: The decision kind is release-fixed and determines which target/reference/status fields are legal.
conditional_fields.OwnerDecisionRequest.expected_status: The decision kind is release-fixed and determines which target/reference/status fields are legal.
conditional_fields.OwnerDecisionRequest.expected_revision_r: The decision kind is release-fixed and determines which target/reference/status fields are legal.
conditional_fields.OwnerDecisionRequest.reason: The decision kind is release-fixed and determines which target/reference/status fields are legal.
